name: Banshees

variantInfo.name: Banshee
notes: Requires 15 Slayer to harm and Priest in Peril to enter the Slayer Tower.
Attacking without earmuffs or a Slayer helmet deals 6 damage per hit and greatly drains all combat stats.

variantInfo.name: Twisted Banshee
notes: Requires 69 Slayer to harm; still assignable under the Banshees task.
Regenerates 1 Hitpoint each time it is attacked, whether or not the hit lands.

locationComparison.name: Slayer Tower (ground floor)
notes: 8 standard Banshees spawn on the eastern side of the ground floor.
Cannon cannot be placed anywhere in the Slayer Tower (prohibited area).
Wear earmuffs or a Slayer helmet to avoid the 6-damage stat-draining scream.

locationComparison.name: Catacombs of Kourend
notes: 6 Twisted Banshee spawns; requires 69 Slayer to harm them.
Cannon cannot be placed in the Catacombs of Kourend (prohibited area).

taskNotes: Banshees require 15 Slayer, 20 combat, and Priest in Peril to be assigned by Turael, Spria, or Mazchna.
slayerTargetId 275 is SYNTHETIC (c2-c3-worklist section 1 allocation contract); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
Earmuffs (ItemID 4166) or a Slayer helmet must be worn, or each Banshee scream deals 6 damage and greatly drains Attack, Strength, Defence, Ranged, Magic, Prayer, and Agility.
Banshees are undead and spectral: the salve amulet and Crumble Undead apply.
Banshees have a 30% elemental weakness to air spells (Twisted Banshee 25%).
The standard Banshee (level 23) is on the Slayer Tower ground floor; the Twisted Banshee (level 89, 69 Slayer to harm) is in the Catacombs of Kourend and regenerates 1 HP per attack.
No task extension unlock exists for Banshees.
recommendedMethod: Wear earmuffs or a Slayer helmet, then kill the ground-floor Banshees with any melee weapon; their low Defence makes weapon choice unimportant. Air spells exploit the 30% elemental weakness for a magic alternative. Higher-level players assigned Twisted Banshees in the Catacombs should still wear earmuffs and out-damage the 1 HP-per-attack regeneration.
